rationale_bullets: The fourth consecutive transfer-QB bet, but the first all-league one: Joseph (78.9 PFF/355 at ODU, SBC -1 -> 77.9, ~p68 tape) - Sun Belt OPOY (Athlon), 1,000+ rush yards with two 75-yd TDs vs Indiana, 4,200/1,600/56 TD over two seasons.

The fit is the case: 'a true dual-threat... a mobile element that the program has been missing' (P6); the RVO play-action downfield scheme matches his ODU profile (Athlon); Joseph out-gained the entire '25 Wisconsin team in 10+ yard runs, 37-33.
What he replaces: PASS p0 and 12 ppg (P4-worst) after Edwards (play 3) and O'Neil (game 4) went down - three straight years of early transfer-QB injuries.
Depth: O'Neil returns for fall camp (51.3/123) with C. Smith (42.4/60) - proven-bad but present.
62, M: a ~p68 G5-adjusted dual-threat entering a P4 rebuild - the Iamaleava-60/Illinois-62 tier on quality, with G5 translation as the variance.

key_players.name: Danny O'Neil
key_players.evidence: 51.3/123; injured game 4; back for fall camp

rationale_bullets: Sama (80.0 PFF/140 at Iowa State, B12 +7 -> 87.0) is the best adjusted RB tape imported by any of the round's bottom-half teams: 1,933 career yards including the 270-yard 2024 'Snowmageddon' game.
Dupree (61.2/120) returns as the '25 lead rusher from a room that missed seven combined games (663 total yards; 3.3 ypc, #128; no 100-yard rusher until game 11); D. Jones (70.1) left for LSU.
Rotation depth arrives: B. Jackson (63.4/36 at USC) + Palmer (70.1/30 at TCU); the staff wants a committee (P6).
The system lift: new OL coach Mateos (Arkansas' #1 adjusted rush offense) + Joseph's own legs.
58, M: an ~87-adjusted lead tape on 140 carries + credible rotation, behind a line still being rebuilt.
The '25 volume leaves: Anthony (67.7/257) + Kekahuna (63.8/172, to UNC) took 'the vast majority of snaps and catches'; TE Mason (67.1/211; team-high 398 yds) and Ballard expired.

The retained pieces are adjudication wins, not proven producers: Hilton (59.3/76; 4*; Withdrawn STAYS - 'the staff kept [him] away from the portal,' P6) + Henry (62.6/32; yr4 override; spring praise) + Brooks (61.1/131) + TE Stec (62.7/52; FR flash before injury).
The imports: Rigby (63.7/251 at OkSt -> 66.7 - the only proven volume) + ex-Top100s Coleman (54.3/86 at Minnesota) and Kearney (56.9/19 at OU) + TE Harris (74.1/146 at BGSU, MAC -7 -> 67.1; 5 TD).
44, M: aggregate ~62 (~p30) with zero proven P4 producers - a Purdue-40/Minnesota-44 class room whose upside is pedigree variance.
data_gaps: no alpha, no proven P4 volume

rationale_bullets: Two starters return (Cubberly 59.2/393, Mandell 62.6/704) plus Heywood - the '25 projected LT who tore his ACL last preseason and has no tape.
The exits sting twice: Brunner (66.5/694) to Indiana with 'a high four-star grade' and Renfro (69.8/225) to Illinois, plus four yr4s including Mahlman (62.9/698).
The patches: Kawecki (62.4/710 at OkSt, B12 +8 -> 70.4 - the starting-C anchor) + Wilkins (61.0/189 at Ole Miss, SEC +13 -> 74.0 small) + Cherry (61.8/25 at Arkansas) + Simmons (FSU, no volume).
The bet is the coach: Mateos arrives from Arkansas' #1 adjusted rush offense to fix run push #129 / RBLK p26.
48, M: a nominal ~64 aggregate carried by small SEC samples and an ACL return - the Rutgers-50/MSU-46 tier.

key_players.name: Kevin Heywood
key_players.evidence: '25 projected starter; preseason ACL - no tape

rationale_bullets: The purge: eight yr4 tapes expire at once - Reiger (82.4 PFF/514) and Peterson (81.0/385) headline 'the top four defensive linemen [and] top four outside backers are all gone' (P6) - off a front that graded RDEF p74 / PRSH p79 and held Washington and Illinois to 10 points apiece.
The returning ends are real: Cheeks (70.2/368, B10 +10 -> 80.2; #2 in pressures) + Fearbry (78.2/73 -> 88.2 - elite small sample) + Perkins (62.9/73; Withdrawn STAYS).

The interior is all-G5 projection: Poyser (71.0/423 at Buffalo, MAC -6 -> 65.0; All-MAC) + Cooper (66.1/395 at App State -> 60.1) + Boone (54.5/444 at Arkansas) + Russell (63.7/226 at WVU -> 66.7) + the D3 'roulette chip' Danitz.
Athlon's ceiling condition: 'the progression of homegrown edge defenders... Clayton and Jaylen Williams.'
52, M: one proven B10 edge at volume + one small-sample stud + a G5 interior - the Rutgers-54 shape with a better top and thinner middle.
data_gaps: edge depth behind the top two

rationale_bullets: The phenom pair is the roster's crown: Posa (80.0 PFF/363, B10 +16 -> 96.0 - the scale top; ALL-BIG TEN HONORS AS A TRUE FRESHMAN) + Catalano (69.4/362 -> 85.4) - first and second in tackles with 117 tackles and 6 sacks combined. Both retained ('major retention wins' - Athlon).

The caution nuance cuts FOR them: Posa's 80.0 is elite RAW - the caution rule targets offset-inflation, and his number precedes the +16; the All-B10 honor corroborates. The samples (~360 snaps each) are the only tempering.
The veteran depth left (Alliegro 62.3/449 to OSU; Curtis 63.3/321 to UCF) - Kamara (58.2/239 at Kansas -> 63.2) and Heiberger (95 snaps) are the two-deep.
The scheme plans situational Posa pass-rush usage 'to get him near the ball as often as possible' (Athlon).
74, M: an Indiana-class top two with a two-deep cliff - graded between Indiana's 77 and Washington's 72.

key_players.name: Mason Posa
key_players.evidence: 80.0 PFF/363; All-B10 as a TRUE FR

rationale_bullets: 'Five of the top six defensive backs are gone' (P6): Hallman (71.0 PFF/713 - the proven CB), A. Brown (672 snaps), Hill (386) expired; Latimer to WVU, Agard to Virginia, Zachman (79.6/116 - the best rate tape) to Indiana. COV was p22.

The imports are the case: Burks (75.2/605 at Missouri, SEC +5 -> 80.2 - the best incoming tape; 'SEC game experience') + Robinson (70.5/659 at ASU, B12 +2 -> 72.5; 'a certainty, having started the past two years in the Big 12') + Fletcher (64.8/271 at OkSt) + ex-4*s West (67.8/91 at OSU -> 73.8) and Bates (FSU).
Jung (64.2/628 -> 70.2) is the lone returning starter ('filled in well').
Athlon: 'more depth in this unit than there has been throughout Fickell's tenure' - four new starters is still four new starters.
62, M: two quality volume imports + one returning starter + pedigree smalls, into a p22 coverage prior - the Nebraska-65/Minnesota-64 tier, a step under.
data_gaps: corner room built on smalls (Bates 26 snaps)

rationale_bullets: ST rule: start at the p87 as-played SPEC and adjust hard: the P (Bertrams) left for UCF, and the K spot goes to Lahm - whose yr4 override is the round's cleanest (Athlon: 'redshirted last season in order to be eligible this season') but whose FG resume is unproven (a 'big leg as a kickoff specialist').
The investment: the FIRST full-time special teams coordinator of the Fickell era (Ligashesky, poached from Minnesota) - 'more coaching investment in the third phase' (Athlon).
The return game must improve: 7.8 yards on 12 punt returns with heavy fair-catching; Henry (yr4 override) doubles as KR/PR.
48, M: an elite prior minus both proven legs, plus a coordinator upgrade - the Purdue-54 shape without Purdue's proven P.

key_players.name: Gavin Lahm
key_players.evidence: redshirted-for-eligibility (Athlon); big-leg KO man, unproven FG
